author: Шелестов Максим Евгеньевич

long.override: Only resolved initial scenario maxTicks and controller finalTick; different planning horizon, separate cohort

primary: Per-world median NPC capital change at ordinary5000; not accounting profit
contrasts: For each map and bot count, Hard-Medium and Easy-Medium. Paired world/seed differences, exact sign test, Holm over12 predeclared contrasts; deterministic bootstrap95 median CI. n5 cells exploratory; n10 cells primary; no post-hoc selection by effect.
secondary: Physical construction I..V and industry XP unlocks separately; quest XP share; production, actual cash receipts/costs, wages, road liabilities, import/resource snapshots, workforce utilization samples, ownership HHI, overflow, traffic and feasible-action diagnostics.
independence: World/seed. NPCs and segments inside one world are dependent, never new replicates.
censoring: No milestone is zero-filled. Horizon, timeout, save limit and audit failure separate. Failed/pending worlds never dropped silently; completed5000 and last valid partial boundaries reported separately.
human: Observer without economic commands; self ballot. Not a timing study of an experienced human player.
calibration: No price/XP/default edits before results. Versioned opt-in changes only if replicated game evidence identifies a cause; no untested correction to compensate for presumed weak NPC strategy.
stop: Keep600/900s process deadlines, 2MiB input and64/512MiB checkpoint limits. Stop each long world at first runtime/serialization blocker; preserve last complete audited checkpoint, stderr, heartbeat and all attempts. No H2 runtime optimization in this study.
storage: Atomic relative-path journal, frozen inputs/DLLs, OS process lock, explicit failed retry, lossless controller traces. Per-world artifacts retained90days; download to a durable workspace for longer retention. Resume original source revision and verify hashes; never silently continue with another profile/binary.
prepared: Existing F2/E1/E2 controls are separate from natural progression. Cash recovery is not full economic ROI when costs/owner labour are unallocated.
historicalUse: Prior120 ordinary1800 and long map-adapter1 results remain historical evidence. Current layout2 samples are a distinct cohort, not relabelled old observations.
